limitations: All historical targets informed the hypotheses; historical scores are not independent held-out performance.
Market observation/source cutoff is October26; actual forward registration is October28 in America/New_York, with two intervening market sessions unobserved.
Close+60 is reconstructed availability of retained price revisions, not certified historical vendor-vintage availability.
Inherited conditional split-adjusted IBKR TRADES basis and native unverified volume units remain unchanged.
Actual entries, order types, fills, quantities and real exit reasons remain unknown.
Newsletter prediction tests a combined entry/price/reporting bridge; source compatibility does not identify actual broker conventions.
Model E predicts only4/26 offered actual revision directions and3/26 intervals in the original dry run; no thresholds were retuned.
C/D are indistinguishable on resolved historical source-action forecasts at these cutoffs.
Fresh scoring requires known post-registration publication and operator assertions of next-alert/complete-source-chain scope.
Native source bodies and full price views remain local; public files are sealed derived projections.

preservation.scope: All pre-existing files under runs/, data/, reports/, docs/evidence/ and docs/reports/, verified after full regression. README.md is the only modified pre-existing tracked path; all pre-existing research code is unchanged.
